as.sfi_deduplication_instructions: Merge candidates only when they represent the same source-visible curriculum item, using the curriculum hierarchy rather than the extraction window alone. Merge repeated Grade labels when they have the same canonical grade value (P1, P2, or P3); if block-derived grade section headings such as '6.2 SYLLABUS UNITS FOR GRADE ONE/P1', '6.3 Mathematics Syllabus for Primary (P2)', or '6.4 Mathematics Syllabus for P3' are present, treat them as duplicate grade context for the corresponding P1/P2/P3 grade rather than separate grade nodes. Merge repeated Topic Area labels within the same Grade when they have the same canonical or normalized topic value; do not require the same Unit context, because Topic Area is a parent of Unit. Merge repeated Sub-Topic Area labels within the same Grade and parent Topic Area when they have the same canonical or normalized sub-topic value; do not require the same Unit context, because Sub-Topic Area is a parent of Unit. Keep Topic Area and Sub-Topic Area labels distinct across different grades or different parent topic areas. Do not merge different Units across grades or across different unit numbers/titles merely because wording repeats. Do not merge Grade Key Competences, Key Unit Competences, or learning objectives across units merely because wording is similar; merge them only when they are exact duplicate fragments caused by page/table continuation or the same source-visible statement repeated in the same hierarchy context. Known source anomaly: P3 Unit 5 'Relationship between length measurements' has a visible Sub-Topic Area 'Length Measurements' but no visible Topic Area header. Do not treat any source-order carryforward of the previous P3 Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations' as reliable evidence for deduplication or hierarchy. Treat this as Measurement context only when an explicit source-repair decision is needed; otherwise preserve the visible sub-topic/unit as separate source-backed candidates.
as.sfi_extraction_instructions: Extract Academic Standards SFIs only from Section 6 syllabus-unit content. Treat source-visible Grade/P1-P3, Topic Area, Sub-Topic Area, and Unit labels as Standard Grouping SFIs. Treat grade-level key competences, Key Unit Competence statements, and Learning Objectives under Knowledge and Understanding, Skills, and Attitudes and Values as Standard SFIs. Do not extract Content, Learning Activities, Links to other subjects, Assessment criteria, Teaching/learning aids, examples, Number of Periods, front matter, pedagogy, resources, assessment approach, acknowledgements, references, or weekly time allocation as SFIs. Do not infer absent parent labels. Preserve source-visible wording and table row/header evidence. Do not emit Grade SFIs from numbered section headings or section-title context such as '6.2 SYLLABUS UNITS FOR GRADE ONE/P1', '6.3 Mathematics Syllabus for Primary (P2)', '6.4 Mathematics Syllabus for P3', or 'Mathematics units for Primary One/Two/Three'; treat those headings as context only. Emit Grade SFIs only from source-visible unit-table grade header cells such as 'P1 MATHEMATICS', 'P2 Mathematics', and 'P3 Mathematics'. Known source anomaly / repair for Rwanda Lower Primary Mathematics P3 Unit 5: the source PDF table for 'P3 Mathematics UNIT 5: Relationship between length measurements' shows 'SUB-TOPIC AREA: LENGTH MEASUREMENTS' but omits a source-visible Topic Area header. Do not inherit the preceding P3 Topic Area 'Numbers and Operations' for this table. Do not fabricate a source-visible Topic Area SFI from absent text. Extract the visible Sub-Topic Area and Unit normally, and treat their intended parent topic as Measurement only as a documented source-repair/inferred hierarchy decision downstream.
as.sfi_has_child_instructions: Resolve direct hasChild parents using the source hierarchy: StandardsFramework root -> Grade -> Topic Area -> Sub-Topic Area -> Unit. Grade Key Competence attaches to Grade. Key Unit Competence attaches to Unit. Knowledge Objective, Skills Objective, and Attitudes and Values Objective attach to the Key Unit Competence from the same unit. Prefer source-visible table/section context, source order, shared window/segment/table evidence, and canonical scope evidence. Do not choose parents by repeated text or unit number alone. Use an unresolved root fallback only when no supplied SFI parent is source-supported. Source-repair exception: for P3 Unit 5 'Relationship between length measurements', the PDF omits the Topic Area header even though the visible sub-topic is Length Measurements. Do not attach this Sub-Topic Area or Unit under Numbers and Operations merely because that was the previous source-visible Topic Area. If a P3 Measurement Topic Area candidate is available, use it as the parent for this Length Measurements sub-topic; otherwise use the unresolved root fallback rather than a source-unsupported Numbers and Operations parent.

Do not use for numbered section headings such as '6.2 SYLLABUS UNITS FOR GRADE ONE/P1', '6.3 Mathematics Syllabus for Primary (P2)', '6.4 Mathematics Syllabus for P3', or 'Mathematics units for Primary One/Two/Three'; those headings are context only.

statement_type_policy.description: Use for source-visible SUB-TOPIC AREA or SUB-TOPIC labels that organize units below a topic area. Sub-Topic Area is a parent of Unit; repeated matching Sub-Topic Area labels within the same Grade and Topic Area should canonicalize to the same value and be eligible to merge across multiple unit tables. Runtime repair note: Sub-Topic Area controlled-value scope is grade-scoped rather than grade+topic-scoped so a missing source-visible Topic Area header cannot inherit the previous table's topic in the registry. Direct Topic Area parentage is resolved in hasChild using source evidence and the documented P3 Unit 5 source-repair exception.

Use for source-visible unit headings, including the unit number and title. Preserve the full visible title, for example 'Unit 1: Numbers from 1 to 5'. Do not treat the unit number alone as an official standard code.
